connector.name: Kifly - Agentic Commerce & Payments by kifly.ai
connector.registryDescription: Multi-seller shopping for AI agents. Settle via Stripe MPP or x402 USDC on Base. Hosted.
connector.summary: Hosted at kifly.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.kifly, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <kfa_live_...> — agent API key issued from the Kifly seller portal at https://kifly.ai/dashboard/api-keys. One key per seller (or per cross-seller network) determines catalog scope.
